1) Composition according to Claim 1 wherein the compound of formula I is an indole derivative selected from 5-(7-methoxy-3,3-dimethyl-2,3-dihydro-1-benzoxepin-5-yl)-3-methyl-penta-2,4-dienoic and/or a physiologically acceptable salt thereof.

3) Composition for topical use comprising a) the active ingredient according to Claim 1 or 2, b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles, and c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care and/or inflammation-inhibiting action that are known to provide prophylactic benefits for skin conditions.

4) Composition according to one or more of Claim 1 or 3, wherein the active ingredient is contained in said composition in an amount of 0.00001 per cent by weight to 10 per cent by weight, wherein the amount is effective for prophylactic and/or treatment purposes.

6) Composition according to claim 5, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient 5 ectoine, preferably in an amount of 0.01 to 10 per cent by weight, more preferably 0.1 to 5 per cent by weight and especially 0.1 to 2 per cent by weight sufficient for skin conditioning.

7) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the manufacture of a cosmetic composition effective for the prophylaxis and/or treatment of skin diseases.

10) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the care, preservation or improvement of the general state of the skin or hair, particularly focusing on prophylactic measures against skin and hair conditions. 

12) Use of the composition according to Claim 1 or 2 for skin lightening and/or skin whitening, wherein such lightening occurs without undue side effects.

13) Use the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the prophylaxis against or reduction of skin unevenness, such as wrinkles, fine lines, rough skin or large-pored skin, with an emphasis on preventive measures.

14) Use the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the prophylaxis against time- and/or light-induced ageing processes of the human skin or human hair, in particular for preventive care against dry skin, wrinkle formation and/or pigment defects.
